articles.title: Atlantis port fuel depot blast injures six workers
articles.rss_description: A fuel tank exploded at the port of Atlantis early Monday, injuring six workers, officials said. The cause is under investigation.

articles.title: Six hurt in blast at Atlantis port storage depot
articles.rss_description: Six people were injured in an explosion at a storage depot near Atlantis port, emergency services said. No deaths were reported.

articles.title: Atlantis parliament passes new data privacy law
articles.rss_description: Atlantis lawmakers approved a new data privacy law on Monday, which officials said would give residents more control over personal data.
